title: 《科学》说2026年11月13日是末日？
title_en: Science said the world ends Nov 13, 2026?

segments.zh: In 1960, three scientists did the math,
segments.en: 1960年，三位科学家算了一笔账，

segments.zh: and set the end of the world for November 13, 2026.
segments.en: 把世界末日定在了2026年11月13日。

segments.zh: That's less than four weeks from today.
segments.en: 离今天不到四个星期。

segments.zh: Friday the 13th, of course.
segments.en: 当然，还是个黑色星期五。

segments.zh: It was published in Science,
segments.en: 论文发在《科学》杂志上，

segments.zh: one of the most respected journals on Earth.
segments.en: 地球上最受尊敬的期刊之一。

segments.zh: Today's question: why did a serious formula say we'd be squeezed to death?
segments.en: 今天的问题：一个正经公式，为什么说我们会被挤死？

segments.zh: And why are we still here?
segments.en: 我们又为什么还在？

segments.zh: Meet Mo. Mo is just one person.
segments.en: 认识一下小莫。小莫只是一个人。

segments.zh: But Mo has a lot of relatives.
segments.en: 可小莫的亲戚，特别多。

segments.zh: Around 1800, there were about one billion people.
segments.en: 1800年前后，地球上大约十亿人。

segments.zh: By 1927, two billion.
segments.en: 到1927年，二十亿。

segments.zh: By 1974, four billion.
segments.en: 1974年，四十亿。

segments.zh: Each doubling came faster than the last.
segments.en: 每翻一倍，都比上一次更快。

segments.zh: Normal fast growth is exponential:
segments.en: 普通的快速增长叫指数增长：

segments.zh: double, double, double, at a steady pace.
segments.en: 按固定的节奏，翻倍，翻倍，再翻倍。

segments.zh: Like a bank account with a fixed interest rate.
segments.en: 就像利率固定的存款。

segments.zh: It gets huge, but never infinite.
segments.en: 会很大，但永远不会无穷大。

segments.zh: Twist one: the team thought humans grow even faster than exponential.
segments.en: 反转一：他们认为，人类比指数增长还快。

segments.zh: More people means more ideas and more teamwork,
segments.en: 人越多，点子越多，合作越多，

segments.zh: and more ideas mean even faster growth.
segments.en: 点子越多，增长就越快。

segments.zh: So the growth rate itself keeps growing.
segments.en: 增长的速度本身也在增长。

segments.zh: Mathematicians call this hyperbolic growth.
segments.en: 数学家管这叫双曲增长。

segments.zh: Their formula: population equals a big number,
segments.en: 他们的公式：人口等于一个大数，

segments.zh: divided by the years left until 2026.
segments.en: 除以离2026年还剩多少年。

segments.zh: Divide by a smaller and smaller number,
segments.en: 除数越来越小，

segments.zh: and the answer rockets toward infinity.
segments.en: 答案就冲向无穷大。

segments.zh: That's a singularity: a definite date with an infinite answer.
segments.en: 这叫奇点：一个确定的日子，一个无穷大的答案。

segments.zh: The scary part? It fit two thousand years of data,
segments.en: 吓人的是：它拟合了两千年的数据，

segments.zh: 24 estimates of world population.
segments.en: 一共24个世界人口估计值。

segments.zh: it came surprisingly close every time.
segments.en: 它都算得八九不离十。

segments.zh: Experts wrote in calling it ridiculous.
segments.en: 专家写信说它荒唐。

segments.zh: The authors fought back.
segments.en: 作者照样据理力争。

segments.zh: Twist two: plug today's date into the formula,
segments.en: 反转二：把今天的日期代进公式，

segments.zh: and Earth should hold about 2.5 trillion people.
segments.en: 地球上应该有大约两万五千亿人。

segments.zh: That's three hundred people
segments.en: 相当于每个真人身边，

segments.zh: for every person actually alive.
segments.en: 再挤上三百个。

segments.zh: The real number? About 8.3 billion.
segments.en: 真实的数字呢？大约八十三亿。

segments.zh: So what bent the curve?
segments.en: 是什么把曲线掰弯了？

segments.zh: Not famine. Not war.
segments.en: 不是饥荒，也不是战争。

segments.zh: Right around the early 1960s, the growth rate peaked,
segments.en: 就在1960年代初，人口增长率到顶，

segments.zh: and then started falling.
segments.en: 然后开始往下走。

segments.zh: Kids stopped dying young.
segments.en: 孩子不再早早夭折。

segments.zh: And when most kids survive, families choose to have fewer.
segments.en: 大多数孩子能长大，家庭就选择少生。

segments.zh: Today the global birth rate
segments.en: 今天全球的出生率，

segments.zh: is less than half of what it was in 1960.
segments.en: 还不到1960年的一半。

segments.zh: Twist three: the authors had a prescription:
segments.en: 反转三：作者当年开过一个药方：

segments.zh: cut the birth rate in half.
segments.en: 把出生率砍掉一半。

segments.zh: The world roughly did it.
segments.en: 世界差不多真做到了。

segments.zh: In a way, the prophecy cancelled itself.
segments.en: 某种意义上，预言把自己给破了。

segments.zh: When a formula hits infinity,
segments.en: 公式里一出现无穷大，

segments.zh: it usually means the model has stopped describing reality.
segments.en: 通常说明模型已经不再描述现实。

segments.zh: Like a balloon you keep blowing up:
segments.en: 就像一直吹的气球：

segments.zh: the math says forever, the rubber says no.
segments.en: 数学说能无限大，橡皮说不行。

segments.zh: Fun fact: the lead author, von Foerster,
segments.en: 冷知识：第一作者冯·福斯特，

segments.zh: was once a stage magician.
segments.en: 还当过舞台魔术师。

segments.zh: One historian called the paper a magic trick:
segments.en: 一位历史学家说，这篇论文就是个魔术：

segments.zh: ordinary math, extraordinary title.
segments.en: 普通的内容，惊人的标题。

segments.zh: And the trick worked: Time magazine and the New York Times covered it.
segments.en: 魔术成功了：《时代》周刊和《纽约时报》都报道了它。

segments.zh: Friendly fine print: the formula was never a real forecast.
segments.en: 友情提示：这个公式从来不是真预言，

segments.zh: It was a warning about a curve.
segments.en: 它是一个关于曲线的警告。

segments.zh: Today population growth is slowing,
segments.en: 如今人口增长在放慢，

segments.zh: and many countries now worry about too few babies.
segments.en: 不少国家反倒发愁孩子太少。

segments.zh: So on November 13, relax. Mo is fine.
segments.en: 所以11月13号，放轻松，小莫没事。

segments.zh: Maybe just don't schedule anything important.
segments.en: 不过那天，重要的事还是别排了。
